record.paper_title: Open problems in the theory of completely positive and copositive matrices
record.context_brief: facial structure of CP and COP cones
record.original_question: Characterize the faces of COP_n and CP_n. Here COP_n is the cone of real symmetric n x n matrices A with x^T A x >= 0 for every x in R_+^n, CP_n is the cone of real symmetric n x n matrices A = B B^T for some entrywise nonnegative B, and a face F of a closed convex cone K is a subset such that every line segment in K with an interior point in F has both endpoints in F.

evidence.quote: The facial structure of COPn and CPn is not yet fully understood.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{S}^n$ denote the space of real symmetric $n\times n$ matrices. Define the copositive cone
$$\mathrm{COP}_n = \{A \in \mathcal{S}^n : x^T A x \geq 0 \text{ for all } x \in \mathbb{R}^n_+\},$$
and the completely positive cone
$$\mathrm{CP}_n = \{A \in \mathcal{S}^n : A = BB^T \text{ for some entrywise nonnegative matrix } B\}.$$
Both are closed convex cones in $\mathcal{S}^n$, and they are dual to each other under the trace inner product. A face $F$ of a closed convex cone $K$ is a convex subcone with the property that whenever a line segment in $K$ has an interior (relative) point lying in $F$, both endpoints of the segment lie in $F$.

Problem: Give a complete characterization of the faces of $\mathrm{COP}_n$ and of $\mathrm{CP}_n$ for general $n$. In particular, describe all maximal faces, all extreme rays, and determine which faces are exposed.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2020–2026) has produced partial results: explicit face representations via zero and minimal zero vectors, characterizations for small $n$ (notably $n=5$), non-exposedness phenomena in $\mathrm{CP}_n$ for $n\geq 5$, and analogous studies over second-order cones. However, the literature explicitly notes that the structure of maximal faces and extreme exposed rays in higher dimensions remains poorly understood, indicating the problem is still open in general.

status_evidence.title: Refined Estimates on the Dimensions of Maximal Faces of Completely Positive Cones
status_evidence.snippet: The structure of maximal faces of the cone of completely positive matrices is still not well understood in higher dimensions.
status_evidence.claim: General facial structure of CP_n remains open in higher dimensions.

status_evidence.title: Structural Properties of Faces of the Cone of Copositive Matrices
status_evidence.snippet: Several explicit representations of faces of the copositive cone have been obtained based on zero and minimal zero vectors.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial characterizations of faces of COP_n are known.

status_evidence.title: Facial structure of copositive and completely positive cones over a second-order cone
status_evidence.snippet: Classifies faces of copositive and completely positive cones over a second-order cone.
status_evidence.claim: Active recent research, indicating the nonnegative-orthant case remains under study.

status_evidence.title: Faces of the 5x5 completely positive cone
status_evidence.claim: Even for small n, full facial structure has only recently been investigated.
